# Customizing the Deskbell widget

Four layers, each an escape hatch for the one below. Most deployments stop at the first.

1. **Dashboard** — set appearance on the Appearance page; no code, no redeploy.
2. **Attributes** — override anything per page from the embed code.
3. **CSS** — `--deskbell-*` custom properties for colour, and `::part()` for shape.
4. **Slots** — replace the launcher, header, empty state or footer with your own markup.

Precedence, lowest to highest:

```
defaults  <  dashboard config  <  attributes / JS config  <  host-page CSS
```

Host-page CSS wins last on purpose. `deskbell-widget { --deskbell-accent: red }` is the
most explicit statement of intent on the page, so nothing resolved at runtime beats it.

## Quick start

One tag. There is no `api-url` to configure: `deskbell.js` is served by your own
Deskbell deployment, so the script's origin is the API origin.

```html
<script
  async
  src="https://your-deskbell/deskbell.js"
  data-project-key="pk_live_..."
  data-accent="#2b6b4f"
  data-color-scheme="auto"
  data-launcher-label="Ask AI"
  data-suggested-questions="How do I install?|What does it cost?"
></script>
```

Every option below works as `data-<attribute>` on that tag.

List options (`suggested-questions`) are separated by `|`, because questions contain
commas. Object options (`theme`, `copy`, `prompt-groups`, `feedback-reasons`) take JSON.

### Placing the element yourself

Drop `data-project-key` and write the element instead when you need to control where
it sits in the DOM. Auto-mount stands down whenever a `<deskbell-widget>` already
exists, so the two never collide.

```html
<script async src="https://your-deskbell/deskbell.js"></script>
<deskbell-widget
  project-key="pk_live_..."
  api-url="https://your-deskbell"
  color-scheme="auto"
></deskbell-widget>
```

The two forms use the same names — the script tag prefixes them with `data-`.
The table below gives the element form.

## Options

### Identity

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project-key` | string | — | Public widget key. Not a secret — origin binding is the control. |
| `api-url` | string | — | Your Deskbell server. Leave empty when the widget is on the same origin. |
| `locale` | string | — | BCP-47 tag for the visitor's language. Defaults to the browser's. |
| `context` | context | — | Where on your site the conversation starts, as JSON: { "account": { "id": "…", "name": "…" } }. Stored with the thread, shown in the dashboard. |
| `readonly` | boolean | `false` | Show one conversation with no composer, for support staff whose token carries the project's staff claim. |
| `conversation-id` | string | — | The conversation to open on load. With read-only it loads through the staff preview. |

### Theme

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color-scheme` | `light` \| `dark` \| `auto` | `light` | Light, dark, or follow the visitor's system setting. |
| `accent` | CSS value | `#2b6b4f` | Drives the launcher, header, your messages and focus rings. |
| `radius` | CSS value | `16px` | Border radius of the chat panel, e.g. 16px or 0. |
| `font` | CSS value | `system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif` | Any CSS font-family value. Load the font on your own page. |
| `theme` | object | — | Fine-grained overrides for any of the widget's CSS custom properties. |
| `color-scheme-selector` | string | — | CSS selector of the element your site keeps its theme on, e.g. html. A dark or light class or data-theme there overrides the colour scheme. |

### Launcher

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `launcher` | `bell` \| `chat` \| `sparkle` \| `none` | `bell` | Built-in icon, or 'none' if you open the widget from your own button. |
| `launcher-icon-url` | string | — | Square image used instead of the built-in icon. |
| `launcher-label` | string | — | Text beside the icon, e.g. 'Ask AI'. Turns the circle into a pill. |
| `position` | `bottom-right` \| `bottom-left` | `bottom-right` | Which corner the launcher sits in. |
| `offset-x` | number | `20` | Distance from the side of the viewport, in pixels. |
| `offset-y` | number | `20` | Distance from the bottom of the viewport, in pixels. |
| `launcher-draggable` | boolean | `false` | Let visitors drag the launcher anywhere on screen. The panel follows; the position is not remembered. |

### Behaviour

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `floating` \| `inline` | `floating` | Floating: a launcher opens a panel. Inline: the widget fills its container and is always open; give the element a height. |
| `open-on-load` | boolean | `false` | Open the panel automatically when the page loads. |
| `trigger-selector` | string | — | CSS selector — clicking any matching element opens the widget. |
| `hotkey` | string | — | Shortcut that opens the widget, e.g. mod+k. Empty to disable. |
| `conversation-history` | boolean | `true` | Let visitors return to their recent conversations. |
| `history-layout` | `stack` \| `sidebar` | `stack` | Stack: a list view behind a back button. Sidebar: threads in a collapsible rail beside the conversation, with delete. |
| `resume-thread` | `last` \| `newest` \| `none` | `last` | What a fresh open shows: the thread this browser last had open, the visitor's newest thread, or nothing. |
| `thread-idle-minutes` | number | `30` | A thread silent for this long is not resumed; the next question starts a new one. 0 never rolls over. |
| `scope-key` | string | — | A key of the page's context. When present, the sidebar can show only the threads started under that key's value. |
| `feedback` | boolean | `true` | Show thumbs up/down under answers. Feeds the docs-gap analytics. |
| `feedback-reasons` | JSON array | — | Reasons offered on a downvote, each with an id, a label and an optional free-text limit. JSON; empty means the built-in three. |

### Content

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `suggested-questions` | list, max 4 | — | Up to four starter questions shown in the empty state. |
| `prompt-groups` | JSON array | — | Cards in the empty state, each a title, optional description and icon, and up to six prompts. JSON; replaces the suggested questions when set. |
| `disclaimer` | string | — | Short notice above the footer, e.g. that answers are AI-generated. Markdown links work. |
| `copy` | object | — | Override any of the widget's UI strings. |
| `powered-by` | boolean | `true` | Removing the badge requires an enterprise licence. |

## Theme tokens

Set these anywhere in your CSS — they pierce the shadow boundary. Colour tokens have
light and dark values built in; `color-scheme` picks between them.

```css
deskbell-widget {
  --deskbell-accent: #2b6b4f;
  --deskbell-surface: #ffffff;
  --deskbell-radius: 16px;
}
```

| Token | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `--deskbell-surface` | Panel background |
| `--deskbell-surface-subtle` | Assistant bubbles, pills, chips |
| `--deskbell-surface-hover` | Hover background for rows and buttons |
| `--deskbell-surface-active` | Pressed/active background |
| `--deskbell-text` | Primary text |
| `--deskbell-text-secondary` | Chip and pill text |
| `--deskbell-text-muted` | Secondary text, refusals, empty state |
| `--deskbell-text-subtle` | Timestamps, labels, placeholders |
| `--deskbell-border` | Dividers and input borders |
| `--deskbell-border-strong` | Chip borders |
| `--deskbell-accent` | Brand colour |
| `--deskbell-accent-contrast` | Text on the accent colour |
| `--deskbell-accent-subtle` | Tinted accent background |
| `--deskbell-header-bg` | Panel header background |
| `--deskbell-header-text` | Panel header text |
| `--deskbell-bubble-user-bg` | Visitor message background |
| `--deskbell-bubble-user-fg` | Visitor message text |
| `--deskbell-bubble-assistant-bg` | Answer background |
| `--deskbell-bubble-assistant-fg` | Answer text |
| `--deskbell-bubble-radius` | Message bubble radius |
| `--deskbell-launcher-bg` | Launcher background |
| `--deskbell-launcher-fg` | Launcher icon colour |
| `--deskbell-launcher-size` | Launcher diameter |
| `--deskbell-launcher-offset-x` | Launcher distance from the side |
| `--deskbell-launcher-offset-y` | Launcher distance from the bottom |
| `--deskbell-radius` | Panel corner radius |
| `--deskbell-panel-width` | Panel width |
| `--deskbell-panel-height` | Panel height |
| `--deskbell-shadow` | Panel shadow |
| `--deskbell-z` | Stacking order |
| `--deskbell-font` | Font stack |
| `--deskbell-font-size` | Base font size |
| `--deskbell-control-radius` | Pills and buttons |
| `--deskbell-input-radius` | Text inputs |
| `--deskbell-focus-ring` | Focus outline colour |
| `--deskbell-code-bg` | Fenced code block background in answers |
| `--deskbell-code-fg` | Fenced code block text in answers |

## Parts

For anything a token cannot express — spacing, borders, layout — style the element
directly with `::part()`.

```css
deskbell-widget::part(launcher) { border-radius: 8px; }
deskbell-widget::part(panel) { width: 520px; }
```

`launcher-container` · `launcher` · `launcher-icon` · `launcher-label` · `panel` · `header` · `header-title` · `header-subtitle` · `back-button` · `close-button` · `list` · `empty-state` · `suggestion` · `message` · `bubble` · `citations` · `hedge` · `citation-pill` · `citation-label` · `feedback` · `feedback-button` · `conversation` · `new-question-button` · `composer` · `composer-input` · `send-button` · `powered-by` · `md-heading` · `md-list` · `md-code` · `md-link` · `header-actions` · `disclaimer` · `typing` · `welcome-title` · `welcome` · `welcome-card` · `welcome-card-icon` · `welcome-card-title` · `welcome-card-description` · `welcome-prompt` · `feedback-note` · `feedback-thanks` · `sidebar` · `sidebar-toggle` · `new-thread-button` · `scope-tabs` · `scope-tab` · `thread` · `thread-title` · `thread-meta` · `thread-delete` · `thread-confirm` · `clarify-options` · `clarify-option` · `actions` · `action` · `action-title` · `action-status` · `action-buttons` · `action-card` · `action-details`

A citation pill also carries `citation-kind-<type>` for its source's connector type,
e.g. `::part(citation-kind-docs-crawler)`.

## Slots

Put your own markup in a slot and it replaces the default entirely — no JS, and the
launcher stays wired: clicking your button opens the widget.

```html
<deskbell-widget project-key="pk_live_...">
  <button slot="launcher" class="my-button">Need help?</button>
</deskbell-widget>
```

`launcher` · `header` · `header-actions` · `empty-state` · `footer`

## Recipes

Layouts the options do not cover but CSS does. Rules the host page writes against
`::part()` beat the widget's own — normal declarations from the outer page win over
shadow-tree rules — so none of this needs `!important`.

### A full-height side panel

```html
<script
  async
  src="https://your-deskbell/deskbell.js"
  data-project-key="pk_live_..."
  data-position="bottom-left"
  data-launcher="none"
  data-open-on-load="true"
></script>
```

```css
deskbell-widget::part(panel) {
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: auto;
  width: min(420px, 100vw);
  border-radius: 0;
}

/* The widget is position: fixed and overlays the page — make room for it. */
body {
  padding-left: min(420px, 100vw);
}
```

Pinning `top` and `bottom` is enough: leave `height: auto` and the panel fills the gap.
Avoid `height: 100vh`, which is wrong on mobile where browser chrome overlaps the
viewport, and there is no `max-height` to clear.

Set `position="bottom-left"` even though the `::part()` rule already sets `left`. It
clears the default `right` offset, which an RTL page would otherwise honour — snapping
the rail back to the opposite edge.

`launcher="none"` drops the bubble and `open-on-load` keeps the rail up; omit both to
open it from your own control instead. The close button still renders — hide it with
`deskbell-widget::part(close-button) { display: none }` if the rail should never close.

### What CSS cannot do

Recent conversations and the open thread are one view, not two panes: the widget shows
one or the other, never both. A layout with the conversation list permanently beside the
thread is out of reach from CSS, because the markup for both never exists at once.

## JavaScript API

```js
deskbell("open");
deskbell("close");
deskbell("toggle");
deskbell("open", { query: "How do I install?", submit: true });
deskbell("ask", "How do I install?");
deskbell("config", { accent: "#7c3aed", colorScheme: "dark" });
deskbell("on", "answer", (e) => analytics.track("Docs answered", e.detail));
deskbell("auth", () => session.accessToken); // signed-in visitors, see docs/widget/identity
deskbell("mount"); // with data-render-on-load="false" on the script tag
deskbell("unmount");
```

To call it before `deskbell.js` has loaded, install the queueing stub first — calls
are replayed in order once the bundle takes over:

```html
<script>
  window.deskbell = function () {
    (window.deskbell.q ??= []).push(arguments);
  };
</script>
```

`config` cannot override anything the host page set in CSS — see the precedence above.

## Events

The widget dispatches `CustomEvent`s on `window`, so a tag manager can read them with
no SDK.

```js
window.addEventListener("deskbell:answer", (e) => {
  analytics.track("Docs answered", e.detail);
});
```

| Event | `detail` |
| --- | --- |
| `deskbell:ready` | — (once per element, after the first paint) |
| `deskbell:opened` | — |
| `deskbell:closed` | — |
| `deskbell:question` | `question`, `conversationId` |
| `deskbell:answer` | `question`, `conversationId`, `messageId`, `answer`, `citations`, `unsupportedTerms` (only when the answer named things the documentation does not contain) |
| `deskbell:refusal` | `question`, `reason` |
| `deskbell:feedback` | `messageId`, `feedback` |
| `deskbell:limited` | `question`, `retryAfter` |
| `deskbell:link` | `href` |
| `deskbell:citation` | `href`, `documentId`, `title` |
| `deskbell:conversation` | `id`, `action` (`created`, `opened`, `reset`, `deleted`) |
| `deskbell:unauthorized` | `question` |
| `deskbell:preview` | `conversationId`, `title`, `owner`, `context` |
| `deskbell:error` | `question`, `status` |

A refusal is a docs gap, not a failure — it is the most valuable event here.
